g.text: From video observations to scene-conditioned human motion
Architecture draft / 25 Oct 2026 / unified EXO and full RGB-to-motion integration remain unvalidated
Existing components; freeze for downstream comparisons
Existing EGO path + proposed unified observation adaptation
ONE DDIM CHAIN / 20 sampling steps / both denoiser calls receive the same x_t and t
EGO / EXO is defined relative to the target person. Ground truth enters supervision and evaluation only.
Offline setting; causal scene caching does not imply an online frontend.
